forms.other:
Check project configuration; do not start a Worker or business execution.

Usage:
  {{.Project}} --environment <name> [--root <directory>] [--env-file <path>] [--local] [--lang <locale>]

Select one declared environment. --root defaults to the current directory.
--env-file explicitly reads one required literal dotenv file; no automatic discovery.
--local opts into that environment's optional Local precedence layer.
--lang overrides effective project language for this invocation. Help and startup
errors use the embedded default without loading configuration.
Successful output is safe JSON metadata and a localized result, never settings.
Invalid i18n.default_locale or language override. Use a nonempty language tag and check the selected variable binding; an empty process value overrides dotenv. Code: {{.Code}}
